recommendations: Observation (not blocking, not a regression): the v2 wording at the §Design Summary (Meta) 5th precedent line 138-140 expanded the dispatch-mandated qualifier 'distinct from ADR-0032's 3-tier per-doc-type vocabulary' to 'distinct from ADR-0008's 4-state intra-pipeline ledger and ADR-0032's 3-tier per-doc-type vocabulary'. This is a strict improvement — aligns with cc-design.md line 63 canonical wording and with the §Project Precedents Established subsection item 5 and Q-CC-1 enumeration. Calling out as transparency, not as a finding.

Observation (carry-forward; not a regression): the Blueprint frontmatter does not declare `doc_type:` explicitly. Per shared-conventions §v2 Amendments, doc_type is universal-required. This was also absent in v1; v1 passed reviewer as PASS_WITH_RECOMMENDATIONS so this is a pre-existing condition, not introduced by v2. May be folded into a future cycle if shared-conventions v2 enforcement is tightened.
